resumeText: Ethan Ross is a GenAI Application Developer at Brightline Apps with two years of experience. He builds Python and React applications that call OpenAI APIs, exposing them through FastAPI services and packaging them with Docker. Previously at Stackhouse Digital he worked as a junior full stack developer shipping web features. He is strong on the application side of GenAI and is actively learning RAG patterns and retrieval pipelines.
